title: Work order lines Create & Edit lets the user mark a core OK/Not-OK and add line history
custom_preconds:
1. A user has a role with Work order lines Create & Edit ON.
  2. A work order has a line with a core-bearing part that has been received and is awaiting a core inspection (OK / Not OK).
custom_steps:
1. Open the work order and go to the line with the core part.
  2. Find the core inspection control (OK / Not OK) on that line.
  3. Mark the core OK (or Not OK).
  4. On the same line, add a line history note about the work done.
  5. Save.
custom_expected:
The core OK / Not OK control is available to this role and saves.

The line history note can be added and saves.

Both marking the core and adding line history are controlled by Work order lines Create & Edit.
viu_status: Blocked-UI: needs a work order line with a cored part to expose the core OK/Not-OK control; no cored-part line was present on the test WOs. Requires seeding a core part on a line (New Part Request with a cored catalog PN) then observe the core control + line history for a WOL C&E role.
evidence: Needs live UI with a cored part.
